### Idolatry Continues
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/idolatry-continues
Passage: 2 Kings 17:41
Points:
- Assyria populated Samaria with foreign nations to break local loyalties and prevent rebellion.
- When lions struck the new inhabitants, the settlers assumed Yahweh was merely a local deity demanding appeaseable customs.
- Even after an exiled priest was returned to teach them, the people merely added the Lord to their pantheon of ancestral idols.
- This syncretistic practice persisted across generations, forming the religious background of the Samaritans in the New Testament.
- God's promised deliverance requires exclusive devotion and sincere worship rather than mixing faith with idolatry.
